title: Flight controller SoM
summary: A flight-controller system-on-module for UBC AeroDesign. The STM32H757, two IMUs, two barometers, a magnetometer, FRAM and microSD sit on one module that plugs into a carrier board through two Hirose DF17 connectors. Rev A is design-complete and not yet fabricated.
